## Description and Rationale

I am an developer with a strong focus on system optimization and complex problem-solving. I registered for the PRC Data Challenge 2026 to tackle a high-impact, real-world aviation problem. I look forward to processing the ADS-B data streams from 11 European airports to build an accurate predictive model for taxi-out times, contributing to better operational efficiency and reduced airport emissions.
